surfaces.dashboard_card: bg-white border border-stone-200 rounded-xl shadow-sm hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-200
surfaces.header: bg-white border-b border-stone-200 sticky top-0 z-50
surfaces.scanner_input: bg-white border-2 border-stone-300 rounded-2xl shadow-[inset_0_2px_4px_rgba(0,0,0,0.06)] focus:border-emerald-500 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-emerald-500/20 text-center text-3xl font-mono transition-all

spacing_and_layout.general: Generous internal padding (p-6, p-8) for containers. Generous gaps (gap-6, gap-8) between sections.

components_strategy.buttons: Rounded-lg font-semibold px-6 py-2. Primary: bg-emerald-700 text-white hover:bg-emerald-800. Secondary: bg-white border border-stone-200 text-stone-700 hover:bg-stone-50.
components_strategy.tables: Shadcn UI table. Clean borders, left-aligned headers. Zebra striping (even:bg-stone-50) for easier reading of dense medical rows. Stick header.
components_strategy.forms: Shadcn UI Form, Input, Select. Stacked labels. Clear error states with rose text and border.
components_strategy.dialogs: Shadcn Dialog. Use for quick IN/OUT scanning manual overrides or adding new supplier.
components_strategy.toast: Sonner toast for scan success/failure (Audio cue matching the visual toast).
components_strategy.charts: Recharts for simple bar charts of stock usage over time. Use emerald and amber colors.

motion_and_interactions.hover: Subtle transform and shadow increase on cards. Color shift on interactive elements.
motion_and_interactions.focus: Clear focus rings (ring-2 ring-emerald-500/50) on all inputs for accessibility.
motion_and_interactions.scanner: When an item is successfully scanned, a brief green flash on the input background and a scaling micro-animation on the success message.

icons.usage: Use stroke-width 2 or 1.5. Clean, consistent sizing (w-5 h-5 for inline, w-8 h-8 for dashboard metrics).

hero_login.description: Professional female dentist sitting in a modern, well-equipped dental office. Use for login screen if present, or welcome modal.

empty_state.description: A female dentist cleaning a patient's teeth in a modern dental clinic. Use for empty state backgrounds with a white/50 overlay.

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid: MANDATORY on all interactive elements. Example: data-testid='scan-input', data-testid='submit-order'
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure all text meets APCA contrast standards. Never use gray-on-gray for crucial data.

modules: Dashboard (Metrics: total products, low stock, expiring soon, recent activity)
Inventaire (Product list, barcode, stock, expiry, search, filter)
Scanner (Dedicated scan page, auto-focused input, quick IN/OUT switch)

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette and typography. Make sure the app looks trustworthy, clinical, and professional.
Ensure the application is single-page or uses robust routing. It is a local desktop app (no auth needed).
Focus heavily on the 'Scanner' UI: the input field must automatically regain focus after a scan so the user doesn't have to touch the mouse.
Implement Shadcn UI components but customize them to match the Organic & Earthy archetype (Stone/Emerald theme). Overuse of standard Shadcn gray looks boring; tint it toward stone.
In the tables, display urgency clearly (e.g., rose-50 background row or icon for low stock/expired items).
Add font links for Manrope and IBM Plex Sans in index.html or layout. (e.g., from Google Fonts).
The UI text must be entirely in French, e.g., 'Tableau de bord', 'Inventaire', 'Scanner', 'Mouvements'.
